explication: AiSOC is a self-hostable AI security operations center. Its central workflow takes pushed or polled security telemetry through normalization and Kafka, detection and alert fusion, then AI investigation with auditable reasoning; human approval gates response actions. Separate product branches provide threat-intelligence ingestion and historical hunting, while the web console exposes alerts, cases, detections, playbooks, compliance, and operational views. The README documents stages and capabilities beyond the sampled code; arrows for those stages reflect that documentation, not inspected implementations.
